d: Small hall with door in the middle open, and workable. Marcantonio sitting in the middle between Dorina, and Medoro. Around him a Choir of His Old Friends, also seated. Lisetta, and Pasquino standing behind others.
Medoro, Dorina, go to Tobias.
Medoro, Tobias, Indi Lisetta.
Headphone shop, or fashionista. In front of the entrance. Bettina alone, garnishing a hat. Around her some Girls, who work, in the direction of Tobia.
Part of the garden, which corresponds to some apartments. Medoro, Dorina, and Lisetta.
Dorina, Lisetta, indi Marcantonio, and Pasquino.
Marcantonio, then Tobia, then Bettina closed in a sedan in a simple dress, then Medoro.
Small room, like the scene before. Dorina, Lisetta, Pasquino.
Pasquino, Lisetta, then Tobias, and Dorina, coming back.
Big room, Medoro, and Bettina.
Marcantonio, Tobias dressed as notary, and sayings.
Choir of Singers, and Players. Lisetta, Dorina, and sayings, then again Tobia in her dress.
An antique-made and furnished room. Dorina, Pasquino, Lisetta, and choir of Falegnami, Muratori, Mercanti di mode, and Bigiottieri.
Marcantonio, Lisetta, and Pasquino.
Bettina in big gala, and sayings, then you're Modest.
The previous Choir, Lisetta, Pasquino, and Marcantonio, indi Bettina, which returns.
Small room, as in the first act. Dorina, Lisetta, indi Medoro, then Tobia, and finally Marcantonio.
Medoro, Dorina, Lisetta, and Marcantonio.
Marcantonio, indi Pasquino.

Wood in the garden with some statues. In the façade a casino for use of the bathrooms with open and workable door, which then closes with key; from one side of the door two windows with ironed even practical. Dark night. Bettina, Tobia, Medoro, in Dorina, then Marcantonio.
Small room, as at the first act. Lisetta, in the Pasquino.

Wood in the garden, night as at the eighth scene. Marcantonio with various Servants, others of which carry torches to wind, others a small table with some chairs. Indi Pasquino in a judge's dress, and the choir of the Old: then Tobia: finally Medoro, and Dorina from the casino, and finally Bettina from the house.
Marcantonio, Medoro, Tobia, and Pasquino.
Large room, as in act I.Dorina, Lisetta, and Pasquino, indi Tobia, Medoro and Marcantonio.
Bettina, then Vecchi's choir.
